correctness.rationale: The exact package proof and verifier agree. The complement of the defining exponent set is 10,11,14, giving parity-check polynomial x cubed plus x plus omega and a three-row cyclic generator. The verifier reconstructs GF(16), the F4 subfield, the cyclotomic cosets, generator polynomial, rank three, and Euclidean self-orthogonality, then exhausts all 64 codewords and obtains weights 0:1, 11:45, 12:15, 15:3. Independently, the normalized generator columns are 15 distinct points of PG(2,4); the six missing points are exactly one projective line plus one off-line point. The 21 projective lines meet the retained set in 0, 3, or 4 points with multiplicities 1, 5, 15, which proves the weight distribution. Exhaustion of all 21 two-dimensional message subspaces gives support sizes 14 or 15 and proves the second generalized Hamming weight 14; the other generalized weights are 11 and 15.
